page.title: Sender identities
page.subtitle: Addresses such as hr@ or it@ that automations of {{org}} may send email as, once verified.
page.empty: Automation emails are sent by the system sender until you add and verify an address of your organization.
page.ownServer: An identity with its own SMTP server always sends directly, through that server.
page.noSmtpTitle: The system email server is not configured
page.noSmtp: Only identities with their own SMTP server can send email. The instance operator sets SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM.
page.whoSees: Only owners and administrators of the organization see this page. Turning an identity off does not turn automations off: their email step fails until the identity is usable again.
page.domains: Addresses of {{domains}} are sent directly. Other addresses are sent on behalf: From is the system address followed by “(via Cellhive)”, and replies go to the identity's address.

statusLine.pendingNone: No valid verification email: send a new one
statusLine.error_auth_failed: The SMTP server keeps refusing the user name or password

transport.systemHint: Sent through the SMTP server of this Cellhive instance.
transport.smtpHint: Cellhive signs in to your organization's mail server with this mailbox.

smtp.title: SMTP server
smtp.hostHint: Name or IP address, without port, e.g. mail.example.com.
smtp.insecure: The password and every email travel in clear text. Use it only inside a trusted local network.
smtp.insecureConfirm: I understand, use an unencrypted connection
smtp.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
smtp.passwordNewHint: The new password replaces the saved one; the identity must be verified again.
smtp.spf: This server must be allowed to send for {{domain}} (SPF) and sign its email (DKIM), otherwise recipients may reject the email (DMARC).
smtp.basicAuth: Both increasingly block signing in to SMTP with a password. Use an app password where your organization allows it; signing in with OAuth is not supported yet.

preview.whySmtp: Sent through your own server: From is this address.
preview.whyNoSmtp: The system email server is not configured: the address is sent on behalf.
preview.whySendAs: {{domain}} is a domain the system server may send for: From is this address.
preview.whyOnBehalf: {{domain}} is not a domain the system server may send for: From is the system address with “(via Cellhive)”, replies go to this address.

form.displayNameHint: Shown as the sender name, e.g. Human Resources.
form.replyToHint: Optional. Empty: replies go to the identity's address.
form.scopeHint: Automation managers of these bases can pick this identity.
form.noBases: There is no base in the organization yet.
form.reverifyTitle: This change needs a new verification.
form.reverify_one: {{name}} goes back to “waiting for verification”. {{count, number}} automation using it fails at its email step until it is verified. Name, signature or bases changes do not need this.
form.reverify_other: {{name}} goes back to “waiting for verification”. {{count, number}} automations using it fail at their email step until it is verified. Name, signature or bases changes do not need this.
form.footnote: A verification email with a link and a 6-digit code goes to this address, valid for 24 hours.
form.footnoteSmtp: Cellhive signs in to the server, then sends a verification email from this address to itself (link and 6-digit code, valid for 24 hours).
form.footnoteEdit: Name, Reply-To, signature and bases change without a new verification.

errors.confirmInsecure: Confirm the unencrypted connection, or choose STARTTLS or TLS.

signature.help: Markdown: **bold**, _italic_, [link](https://…), lists, up to 2 images with “Insert image” (sent inside the email, never as links). No record values.
signature.placeholder: A signature is fixed text: remove the double curly braces (no placeholders).
signature.imageSource: Images must be inserted with “Insert image”: links to images and data: images are not sent.

verify.title: Verify {{email}}
verify.intro: A verification email with a link and a 6-digit code is sent to {{email}}. Whoever reads that mailbox presses “Confirm” in the email, or reads you the code.
verify.introSmtp: Cellhive signs in to {{host}} as {{username}}, then sends a verification email from {{email}} to itself, with a link and a 6-digit code.
verify.sentExpires: The link and the code are valid until {{date}}.
verify.rateLimited: Too many verification emails for now.

steps.label: Test steps
steps.send: Send an email from {{email}} to itself

failure.auth_failed: The server refused the user name or password
failure.send_as_denied: The account may not send as this address
failure.host_not_allowed: This host points to an internal or reserved address
failure.tls_failed: The encrypted connection could not be set up
failure.connection_failed: Could not connect to the server
failure.timeout: The server did not answer in time
failure.smtp_not_configured: The system email server is not configured
failure.unknown: The verification email could not be sent

fix.auth_failed: Check the user name and password. Microsoft 365 and Gmail often block password sign-in: use an app password where allowed.
fix.send_as_denied: Give this mailbox account the right to send as the address (Microsoft 365: “Send As”), or sign in with the address's own mailbox.
fix.host_not_allowed: Use the public name of the mail server. A server in your local network needs SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=true on this instance.
fix.tls_failed: Check the port and the encryption: TLS usually uses port 465, STARTTLS port 587.
fix.connection_failed: Check the host and the port, and that the server accepts connections from this instance.
fix.timeout: Check the host and the port, then try again.
fix.smtp_not_configured: Ask the instance operator to set SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM, or use an own SMTP server.
fix.rejected: Check that the address exists and accepts email, then try again.
fix.temporary: Try again in a few minutes.
fix.unknown: Try again in a few minutes.

verify.codeHint: Paste or type the code from the email.
verify.locked: This code no longer works. Send a new verification email to get a new one.
verify.limits: At most {{perHour, number}} emails an hour per identity, {{perDay, number}} a day per organization.
verify.linkNote: This page does not update by itself when someone confirms through the link; reopen it to see the new status.
verify.errorFix: Fix the server settings (Edit) if they changed, then test and verify again.
verify.disabled: This identity is off. Turn it back on to verify it.
verify.doneHint: Automations of the bases in its scope can now send as this identity.
